record.paper_title: Several Open Problems on Banach Spaces (Castro Urdiales 2014)
record.original_question: For an infinite-dimensional Banach space X with unit ball B and unit sphere S, determine the optimal Lipschitz retraction constant k0(X): the infimum of all k > 0 for which there exists a continuous retraction R from B onto S, equal to the identity on S, satisfying ||R(x)-R(y)|| <= k ||x-y|| for all x,y in B.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be an infinite-dimensional real Banach space with unit ball $B = \{x \in X : \|x\| \le 1\}$ and unit sphere $S = \{x \in X : \|x\| = 1\}$. A map $R : B \to S$ is called a Lipschitz retraction of $B$ onto $S$ if $R$ is continuous, $R(x) = x$ for every $x \in S$, and there exists a constant $k > 0$ such that $\|R(x) - R(y)\| \le k\,\|x - y\|$ for all $x,y \in B$. Define the optimal Lipschitz retraction constant
$$k_0(X) = \inf\{k > 0 : \text{there exists a Lipschitz retraction } R : B \to S \text{ with constant } k\}.$$
Determine the exact value of $k_0(X)$ for an infinite-dimensional Banach space $X$ (in particular, for any specific such $X$, e.g. a separable Hilbert space).
artifact.status_search_result: The exact value of the optimal Lipschitz retraction constant $k_0(X)$ remains unknown for every infinite-dimensional Banach space $X$. Known bounds in the Hilbert space case give $k_0(H) > 4.5$ and an upper bound around 64.5 (Komorowski–Wośko), with a general lower bound $k_0(X) \ge 3$. Recent work (e.g., 2023 arXiv preprint on nonlinear retracts) continues to study the problem without resolving it.

status_evidence.title: On minimal displacement problem and retractions of balls onto spheres
status_evidence.snippet: The exact value of k0(X) is unknown for any infinite-dimensional Banach space X.
status_evidence.claim: Problem of computing k0(X) is open for every X.

status_evidence.title: Nonlinear retracts and the geometry of Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses bounds and known results on Lipschitz retractions of the ball onto the sphere.
status_evidence.claim: Recent survey-style preprint confirms the problem remains open with only bounds known.

status_evidence.title: Retracting a ball onto a sphere in some Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies upper bounds for k0(X) in particular Banach spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Only upper and lower bounds are known; exact values not determined.
